thread:
alex: Heads-up — we had 2 ECC events on node gpu-47 over the last hour, card looks flaky. I'm planning to drain and re-run the preflight log capture. Anyone object?

sophie: go ahead. can you collect full journal + dmesg + nv-smi loop? attach to ticket.

alex: will do. propose we run:
```
journalctl -k -u nvidia-persistenced --since "10m" -o short-iso > /tmp/gpu-47-journal.log
sudo dmesg --level=err,warn -T > /tmp/gpu-47-dmesg.err
for i in {1..60}; do nvidia-smi -q -d ERROR > /tmp/nvsi.$i.log; sleep 1; done
```
... and tar + upload to s3://redwood-gpu-failures/$(date +%s)-gpu-47.tar.gz

matt: also include `cat /sys/class/drm/card*/device/uevent` and `lspci -vvv` output. may help identify BIOS quirks.

jen: +1. can we add a correlation id header to the logs so that console/issue refer to same id? Also record the node heartbeat export metrics: `curl -s http://localhost:9100/metrics | grep -E "gpu_|nvlink" > /tmp/metrics.snap`

alex: done. I'll attach correlation id `corr-1719234567` and upload. quick note: dmesg had repeated Xid 31 lines that looked like memory ECC.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-6482 — gpu-47 ECC spike. Assigned to alex. SLA timer started.

sophie: we should also enable the ephemeral ring buffer at kernel level: `log_buf_len=4M` and set persistent dmesg snapshots to /var/log/gpu-snaps/ to avoid truncation.

matt: long-term: propose small agent that watches for Xid patterns and ships a rolling snapshot (dmesg + nv-smi + journalctl + /proc/interrupts) when threshold crossed. keep retention 7 days.

jen: can we avoid shipping whole journal? gzipped tail + compressed nv-smi repeats should be enough. cost matters when in large fleet.

alex: uploaded tar to s3 (s3://redwood-gpu-failures/1719234678-gpu-47.tar.gz). took snapshot + drain. node cordoned.

sophie: can we add a field in node metadata for 'last_ecc_ts' so autoscaler avoids immediate reusing the same host for new jobs?

matt: good idea. also mark flavor:gpu-47 as 'quarantine' for 24h automatically if Xid>5 in 1h.

alex: running burn-in memtest for 2h now. will report after.

infra-ci: job 2024-06-gpu-health-check queued on gpu-47: memtest started.

jen: thanks all. follow-up: let's make a small PR for the agent next week. I'll proto a collection script and a lightweight uploader.

alex: cool, will paste the upload + what I found in the ticket.
